channel.title: Prateek Saxena — Journal
channel.description: Essays on agentic AI, vibe coding in a suit and business operations from the UAE real economy.

item.title: The Monday Morning Preflight
item.description: Essay by Prateek Saxena introducing the Monday Morning Preflight, an operator's readiness test for AI agents: can they turn Friday's loose ends into a clear Monday operating plan with live ERP data, follow-ups, KPIs and action items. Includes the five checks every business agent must pass. Third entry in the "In a Suit" series.

item.title: I Don't Code. I Brief Agents.
item.description: Essay by Prateek Saxena on agentic AI from the operator's chair: briefing AI agents to turn business intent into dashboards, tools and working software inside real company processes. Second entry in the "In a Suit" series.

item.title: Confessions of an Accidental Vibe Coder
item.description: Essay by Prateek Saxena on "vibe coding in a suit": a business operator using AI agents and plain-language briefing, not code, to build the dashboards and tools a company needs. First entry in the "In a Suit" series.

item.title: After the Prompt: The Operator’s Harness
item.description: Essay by Prateek Saxena on harness engineering for real businesses, the operator's lens, and the Self-Improvement Protocol (SIP) for making AI agents improve safely.
